100771.title: Rear wheel structure
guidance: Inspect 1 EA ML Road Rim (Product Number RM-R600) and 1 EA HL Hub (Product Number HU-8998) for visible damage; treat the hub as a complete subassembly.
Count 36 EA Spokes (Product Number SK-9283) and 36 EA LL Nipple (Product Number NI-4127). Arrange them between the hub and rim using an assumed pattern to be verified; see illustration 100771.

100772.title: Tire, tube and reflector fitting
guidance: Inspect 1 EA ML Road Rim (Product Number RM-R600) and 1 EA HL Hub (Product Number HU-8998) for visible damage; treat the hub as a complete subassembly.

Inspect 1 EA Road Tire Tube (Product Number TT-R982) and 1 EA ML Road Tire (Product Number TI-R628); fit the tube inside the tire and the tire to the rim using an assumed tire lever. Check that the tube is not visibly trapped; see illustration 100772.
Fit 2 EA Reflector (Product Number RF-9198) to the wheel at suitable verified locations. Check their attachment and inspect the completed wheel for visible damage and obvious interference.
